caption:
Figure 2: Overview of GRASP. Real-ISR is cast as visual in-context completion. Local visual
evidence comes from the diptych, global image context from the Vision-Context Bridge over CLIP,
and semantic prompts from LLaVA captions during training and agent refinement during inference.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final GRASP full image and all independent source-pair observations, and read its caption. The full original figure remains intact with global/context, local diptych and semantic branches, frozen/trainable symbols, LoRA, decoder and inference refinement path. Two enlarged views explicitly duplicate the source semantic-prompt and Vision Context Bridge areas rather than represent new computation. The training/inference prompt distinction, agent-document bidirectional arrow, LayerNorm/Linear/GELU/Linear and dimension labels all remain. The new Fire/Snowflake legend restates the original. A tiny source-border fragment at the lower-left enlargement is a visual boundary imperfection, with no omitted scientific content or false connection.
